We’ve lived this problem

Our team has spent over a decade building HR data integrations inside mid-sized and enterprise organizations. We’ve watched integrations drag on for months, break more often than they should, and depend on IT just to keep running.

It’s an infamously slow system. Aragorn came out of that experience.

HR teams shouldn’t have to wait on engineering, rebuild integrations every time something changes, or work around data they don’t trust. They should be able to run their systems directly and keep things moving.

We built Aragorn to give teams clear visibility into their data and real control over how it moves between systems. So integrations are easier to manage, data stays aligned, and changes don’t turn into disruptions.

Built for how HR works

Most integration tools are designed for engineering teams. Aragorn is designed for HR.

It lets you see what’s happening across systems, make changes when you need to, and keep things running without breaking everything downstream.

Our goal is to help you move fast without creating more risk.
